bugs.title: Staff write routes have no Admin Only permission gate
bugs.expected: EMPLOYEE receives 403; a branch-1 user targeting branch-2 staff receives 404
bugs.actual: emp1 POST /api/staff -> 201 {success:true,id:21}; PUT /api/staff/12 -> 200 {success:true}; DELETE /api/staff/12 -> 200 {success:true} and branch-2 row 12 is hard-deleted
bugs.repro: const emp=await loginAs('emp1'); await emp.post('/api/staff').send({name:'X',role:'EMPLOYEE'}); await emp.put('/api/staff/12').send({name:'Hijacked',role:'ADMIN'}); await emp.delete('/api/staff/12');

bugs.title: Staff directory reads ignore branch scope
bugs.expected: branch-1 employee sees only branch-1 staff; GET /api/staff/12 -> 404; ?branch_id=2 and x-branch-id:2 ignored
bugs.actual: emp1 GET /api/staff -> all 20 staff including 'Branch Two Manager' (id 12); GET /api/staff/12 -> 200 with the branch-2 record; spoofed query/header still returns all rows
bugs.repro: const emp=await loginAs('emp1'); await emp.get('/api/staff'); await emp.get('/api/staff/12'); await emp.get('/api/staff?branch_id=2').set('x-branch-id','2');

bugs.title: GET /api/staff/stats reports global counts instead of caller branch

bugs.repro: const emp=await loginAs('emp1'); await emp.get('/api/staff/stats'); compare with SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE branch_id=1.

questions.detail: readme.md:599 lists the route and payload but does not pin the error status. The worker brief says invalid branch id -> 400; the implementation returns 404 {error:'Branch not found.'} for an unknown numeric id. The suite asserts [400,404] for that case and records the malformed-id 500 as A-BUG-6. Please confirm the intended contract.

questions.topic: Hard deletion of doctors/pharmacies with ledger history
questions.detail: readme.md:702/707 says 'Deletes doctor/pharmacy record' without specifying soft delete or ledger handling. DELETE succeeds (200) and FKs SET NULL on client_transactions/orders, leaving ledger rows with NULL client_id/pharmacy_id. No failing test was added because the spec is ambiguous; product decision needed.

questions.topic: Directory-only staff created through POST /api/staff have no credentials
questions.detail: The documented payload (readme.md:728) contains no registration_number/password; both columns are nullable in this schema, so the row is created with NULLs and can never log in. The suite documents this behavior in a passing test. Confirm whether credential creation belongs only to POST /api/admin/staff.

questions.topic: Brief's suspected orders.created_by defect not reproducible
questions.detail: getDoctorOrders selects o.branch_id (not created_by); branch_id is added by migrate_missing_branch_columns.js which the harness applies. GET /api/doctors/1/orders returns 200 with order rows. The separate missing-existence-check problem is A-BUG-4.

questions.topic: Assigned route count in the brief
questions.detail: The brief header says '31' routes but its own lists enumerate 32 (6 auth + 5 admin + 6 staff + 3 clients/debt + 7 doctors + 5 pharmacies). All 32 enumerated routes are in the route table above and each is exercised; no route was added or omitted.

gaps: No shared test-helper gaps: resetDatabase(), loginAs()/loginAsRole(), anon() and clearSessions() were sufficient; no local helper was needed.
No assigned route was impossible to exercise; all 32 enumerated routes reach their handlers.
